posture: Proofs gate withdrawals from a shared pool. The Merkle membership check does not bind the spent note to the leaf, so any prover can withdraw. The owner can swap the verifier at any time. The single most important action is to hash the note into the leaf and bind Index into the path.
out_of_scope: Verifier.sol internals: a stub, not a generated verifier

records.title: Merkle leaf is not bound to the spent note
records.description: Any prover proves membership of any existing leaf with a fresh Secret and withdraws any value.
records.proof: Take any known leaf and its siblings; set Secret=1, Index=7, In.Value=Out.Value=10^18; the witness satisfies every constraint.

records.title: Owner check is skipped when Index is non-zero
records.description: Any prover sets Index to 1 so flag is 0 and the owner equality holds trivially.
records.proof: Index=1 → flag=0 → 0·(In.Owner − Out.Owner) = 0 for any owners.
records.impact: Any prover moves a note to a new owner.

fix.summary: Assert In.Owner == Out.Owner unconditionally, or derive the gate from a constrained bit.

refuter.reasoning: Out.Owner is not used by Pool.withdraw, so ownership has no on-chain effect.
